product.name: Taplo
product.job: Give a business a professional public presence with services, contact, bookings, products, reviews and sharing, managed through Taplo Studio.
audiences: business owners creating and managing a page
customers finding, evaluating and contacting a business

order: verified repository behaviour and product data
authority.rule: Resolve a conflict explicitly; a competitor pattern cannot silently reverse an owner decision. Read current files rather than trusting historical excerpts.
authority.current_request: Construct the Claude Code tools, agents and operating machine. Do not build or redesign the Taplo application during machine setup.

decisions.rule: Account creation comes at the end of guided onboarding; existing authenticated users skip duplicate signup.
Preserve the live page preview behind the movable mobile sheet. Provide accessible full-preview and return controls; adapt to keyboard and small heights without hiding inputs.
Preserve useful Looks/Colours controls and agreed titles including Choose a look. Improve clarity without deleting choice or silently merging distinct state.
Use the actual shared renderer and draft state in onboarding, Studio and customer output. No convincing fake preview that cannot be produced by the engine.
First business content, logo and cover are optional. No-image pages must look intentionally complete through type, colour and composition.
Categories suggest relevant content and functions; they do not restrict taste, layouts or design access.
Changing a design preserves business data, assets, deliberate colour choices and explicit user overrides. Offer reset/undo rather than silent replacement.
Existing saved customer designs remain compatible and visually stable by default; changes are opt-in where required.
Completion saves an unpublished draft. Publication is a distinct explicit action. Never claim a save, account or publication before the relevant operation succeeds.
Preserve current approved fonts unless the current task explicitly authorises typography replacement. Inspect actual font files/configuration rather than inventing font names.
Examples are realistic, replaceable and labelled; sample reviews, availability and services never become unverified business facts.
Recommend a coherent starting design; manual selection remains stable. Asset changes update a recommendation without silently replacing the chosen design.
Initial recommendation is still. Animated treatments require deliberate choice, a good still fallback and reduced-motion support. Do not restore rejected decorative onboarding animation.

Free/Core/Pro/Business and £9.99/£19.99/£39.99 were discussed proposals, not approved entitlement or billing truth. Inspect current authoritative data. Include Free; plan preference is not a paid subscription.
Do not merge or publicly deploy Taplo changes without explicit owner approval. Local/reviewable work proceeds within the authorised task.

scope_history.colour_follow_up: The approved colour/background follow-up preserved fonts, widget structures, illustrations, arrangements and agreed copy. It did not authorise a widget redesign.
scope_history.classification: For each new task declare refinement, redesign or tooling-only. Apply narrow historical restrictions to their original scope; the latest explicit owner instruction may authorise a broader task. Preserve legacy records regardless.
scope_history.colour_reference: Resolve and read the current approved colourway reference from the repository or supplied files before implementing exact values; this seed is not that reference.

taste.interface: Confident, restrained monochrome Taplo chrome, precise typography and spacing; business pages may have their own coordinated colour and identity.
taste.bar: Convincing, useful and distinctive rendered screens, compared on matched content and viewports with specific current references. Apple, Booksy and Linktree are ambitions/research inputs, not a certification or permission to copy.
reject: illustrations or glows used to conceal weak hierarchy
gratuitous phone mockups inside an existing live preview
invented research, adoption or conversion claims
large skill collections treated as proof of capability

commercial_truth: Do not invent plan entitlements, reviews, customer counts, business opening hours, integration availability or live auth/billing behaviour.

repository_paths.approved_colourway_reference: uploaded file c0610833-taplo-approved-colourway-reference.html (not in repository; read it before implementing exact values)
